contract_fixtures.rule: Generate deterministically from frozen public inputs with canonical member order, fixed ZIP timestamps and a recorded derivation hash; do not use ordinary np.savez container bytes as a golden.
Create two deterministic series from frozen public members and record every transformation and output SHA-256.
Use tiny generated arrays for exhaustive dtype and numeric-boundary contracts; public data supplies external validity, not exhaustive type enumeration.

extended_candidates.reason: Eight mixed-shape series provide a stronger optional-reader identity test.
Nine sibling image groups with per-image translations provide a stronger OME-Zarr group-identity test.
The distributed CC0 TIFF is ZCYX; only scikit-image's in-memory helper presents ZYXC, so channel-last coverage would require a documented deterministic derivation rather than an original-file claim.
Real uint16 volumetric labels exercise bounded-memory warnings and later 3D measurement paths.
A large CC0 factorial blur/cell-count corpus is useful for later stress and sensitivity work.
TX, ZX, and TZX CZI files test legitimate acquisitions with no Y axis and prevent silent YX assumptions.
Pinned oiffile conversion of the licensed OIB source can exercise native OIF companion discovery without duplicating another acquisition.
The filename calls this a Z stack while authoritative metadata says TYX, making it a useful guard against filename-based axis inference.

excluded.reason: Technically useful but the provider terms require permission for public non-challenge scientific use and prohibit cloning datasets or subsets. Do not mirror or derive fixtures without written permission.
